cloud_contract: No Cloud deployment is required for RC26.
controlled_parent: Exact accepted FlightCore 4.4.0-rc.24 build 20260905.212756-93deeb4, after successful physical upgrade and genuine fresh-install validation.
home_marker: Extends the existing round-HUD Home feature with one shared solution; exact approved 40 px appearance; display-only projected H on the full primary video and primary-camera PiP; full 3D aircraft/gimbal yaw-pitch-roll transform; in-frame ground projection; smooth directional screen-edge clamp; stale-data suppression; persistent Settings/General toggle defaulting on.
hotfix_state: No mutable hotfix. RC26 is a new immutable candidate.
operator_workflow: Publish, independently verify, run the RC24-to-RC26 read-only preflight, then use the FlightCore Software Update page.
performance_boundary: One page-scoped local same-origin SSE connection reads only the established tmpfs gimbal snapshot at no more than 10 Hz; 75 ms metadata cache; 192-byte event limit; no permanent animation loop; no additional MAVLink request or stream, gimbal command, flight command, logging sample, modem poll, active probe, upload or transmission cadence change.
public_bootstrap: Self-contained RC26 bootstrap; no companion shell helper is required.
registry_gate: Exact accepted RC24 is the controlled upgrade parent; retained clean historical routes and genuine fresh installation remain available. RC25, modified sources and unknown sources fail closed.
rollback_integrity: Canonical release-tree snapshots and restores use one checksummed helper and fail closed on missing, altered, or unverifiable recovery material.
